title: Implement provider-neutral model gateway contract
description:
Define logical model profiles, deployment records, routing policies, invocation audit, Salesforce AI Models integration, LLM Open Connector adapter contract, and qualified fallback behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria
The vertical slice can switch between two qualified mock model deployments without changing its business workflow, prompt contract, or action logic, and every invocation records the selected deployment and policy version.

title: Define model portability and governed experimentation architecture
description:
Define how Agentforce, Salesforce AI Models, BYOLLM, custom providers, and on-prem models connect without leaking provider assumptions into business workflows. Define a governed AutoResearch-style evaluation loop outside production.

## Acceptance Criteria
The repository contains an architecture diagram, model gateway contracts, on-prem constraints, experiment safety boundaries, and linked implementation work.
close_reason: Model portability, on-prem constraints, Salesforce connection surfaces, and governed AutoResearch-style experimentation are documented with implementation beads.

title: Persist roadmap research and recovery protocol
description:
Commit the roadmap, research archive, architecture decisions, development boundaries, source-fetching utility, and agent recovery instructions.

## Acceptance Criteria
Repository documents pass validation and a fresh agent can identify product direction and ready work.
acceptance_criteria: Repository documents pass validation and a fresh agent can identify product direction and ready work.
close_reason: Roadmap, research archive, recovery protocol, decisions, tool boundary, and portable Beads graph validated.

title: Build Lightning command center
description:
Show relationship context, timeline, owner, blockers, evidence, SOP status, recommendation, approval controls, action history, and outcome.

## Acceptance Criteria
A user can complete the vertical slice from one coherent UI with permission-appropriate data.
acceptance_criteria: A user can complete the vertical slice from one coherent UI with permission-appropriate data.

title: Automate vertical-slice verification and demo
description:
Create automated validation, seed and reset flow, end-to-end tests, and a concise demo runbook.

## Acceptance Criteria
A clean environment reproduces the full vertical slice and all material failure-path tests pass.
acceptance_criteria: A clean environment reproduces the full vertical slice and all material failure-path tests pass.

title: Scaffold Salesforce DX project
description:
Create the Salesforce DX structure, scratch or development environment documentation, manifests, and baseline test commands.

## Acceptance Criteria
A clean clone can validate the Salesforce project structure and run its baseline checks.
acceptance_criteria: A clean clone can validate the Salesforce project structure and run its baseline checks.

title: Seed ontology and SHACL validation
description:
Create initial OWL classes, properties, JSON-LD context, SHACL shapes, and valid and invalid examples for the vertical slice.

## Acceptance Criteria
Valid examples pass and invalid examples fail with useful shape violations.
acceptance_criteria: Valid examples pass and invalid examples fail with useful shape violations.

title: Define event contract and synthetic case fixtures
description:
Define the versioned event envelope and a domain-neutral case spanning person, organization, employee, supplier, agreement, SOP, and issue.

## Acceptance Criteria
Fixtures cover normal, duplicate, malformed, late, and conflicting inputs.
acceptance_criteria: Fixtures cover normal, duplicate, malformed, late, and conflicting inputs.

title: Create core Salesforce metadata
description:
Create initial objects and fields for entities, relationships, events, participants, agreements, work, SOP execution, evidence, recommendations, approvals, actions, outcomes, and evaluations.

## Acceptance Criteria
Metadata deploys and enforces required relationships and access assumptions for the vertical slice.
acceptance_criteria: Metadata deploys and enforces required relationships and access assumptions for the vertical slice.

title: Implement Apex context and action services
description:
Implement context retrieval, recommendation storage, approval, action logging, outcome capture, provenance lookup, and tests.

## Acceptance Criteria
Services pass success, denial, invalid-state, and partial-failure tests.
acceptance_criteria: Services pass success, denial, invalid-state, and partial-failure tests.

title: Define MuleSoft APIs and mock adapters
description:
Create OpenAPI contracts for ingestion, context, action execution, and outcome callbacks plus mocked source and write-back behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria
Contract tests prove idempotency, error responses, correlation, retries, and outcome callbacks.
acceptance_criteria: Contract tests prove idempotency, error responses, correlation, retries, and outcome callbacks.

title: First complete vertical slice
description:
Deliver source event through mapping, work, recommendation, approval, mocked action, outcome, and updated user view.

## Success Criteria
The entire path runs from a clean clone with automated tests and no manual database edits.
acceptance_criteria: The entire path runs from a clean clone with automated tests and no manual database edits.

title: C12 Security governance and enterprise readiness
description:
Implement isolation, authorization, purpose, consent, retention, segregation of duties, agent audit, recovery, and connector replacement tests.

## Success Criteria
Security, privacy, failure recovery, and real-source replacement tests pass without weakening audit history.
acceptance_criteria: Security, privacy, failure recovery, and real-source replacement tests pass without weakening audit history.

title: C01 Source intake and event contracts
description:
Implement MuleSoft source boundaries, versioned event contracts, source preservation, retries, replay, deduplication, and synthetic feeds.

## Success Criteria
Valid, duplicate, malformed, late, missing, and out-of-order events produce deterministic observable results.
acceptance_criteria: Valid, duplicate, malformed, late, missing, and out-of-order events produce deterministic observable results.

title: C02 Shared semantics and provenance
description:
Define OWL and SKOS vocabulary, SHACL validation, PROV-compatible provenance, mappings, and bitemporal assertions.

## Success Criteria
Examples validate, preserve source terminology, and answer current-state and historical-belief questions.
acceptance_criteria: Examples validate, preserve source terminology, and answer current-state and historical-belief questions.

title: C03 Identity relationships and history
description:
Resolve source identities with visible confidence, corrections, typed relationships, participants, and evidence-bearing history.

## Success Criteria
Users can inspect, explain, correct, and traverse identities and relationship history.
acceptance_criteria: Users can inspect, explain, correct, and traverse identities and relationship history.

title: C04 Cross-functional work and SOP execution
description:
Implement work items, ownership, dependencies, executable SOPs, evidence requirements, escalation, handoffs, and verified closure.

## Success Criteria
One domain-neutral case crosses teams, supplier, agreement, SOP, and approval without losing context.
acceptance_criteria: One domain-neutral case crosses teams, supplier, agreement, SOP, and approval without losing context.

title: C00 Project control and recovery
description:
Make product direction, evidence, decisions, work dependencies, and clean-session recovery durable in the repository.

## Success Criteria
A new collaborator can clone the repo, understand the product, inspect research, run bd prime, and identify unblocked work without prior chat.
acceptance_criteria: A new collaborator can clone the repo, understand the product, inspect research, run bd prime, and identify unblocked work without prior chat.
close_reason: Clean-clone recovery test passed and foundation checkpoint is committed in repository artifacts.

title: Build governed evaluation and experiment registry
description:
Implement versioned evaluation suites, authorized dataset snapshots, experiment runs, candidate lineage, multi-metric scoring, and human promotion records for bounded AutoResearch-style loops.

## Acceptance Criteria
An isolated experiment can compare a baseline and candidate, retain all results, reject regressions, and require human promotion before changing production configuration.

title: Expose Agentforce explanation and approval actions
description:
Expose grounded case explanation, evidence citations, recommendation generation, and approval request actions without autonomous execution.

## Acceptance Criteria
Agentforce refuses inaccessible data and unauthorized actions and cites evidence for supported answers.
acceptance_criteria: Agentforce refuses inaccessible data and unauthorized actions and cites evidence for supported answers.

title: C11 Product memory and outcome learning
description:
Implement permission-aware episodic, semantic, procedural, and outcome memory with reviewed promotion and evaluation.

## Success Criteria
A later recommendation can cite a relevant prior outcome, explain applicability, and respect current permissions.
acceptance_criteria: A later recommendation can cite a relevant prior outcome, explain applicability, and respect current permissions.

title: C05 Metrics and attribution
description:
Implement versioned metric definitions and reproducible attribution for any defined business outcome.

## Success Criteria
Independent recalculation from source events reproduces displayed metrics and attribution.
acceptance_criteria: Independent recalculation from source events reproduces displayed metrics and attribution.

title: C06 Recommendations and predictive signals
description:
Build transparent baseline rules, predictive signals, evidence-backed recommendations, hypotheses, and explainable Agentforce responses.

## Success Criteria
Every recommendation is explainable from accessible evidence and can be rejected without changing source facts.
acceptance_criteria: Every recommendation is explainable from accessible evidence and can be rejected without changing source facts.

title: C07 Human approval actions and outreach
description:
Implement policy checks, approvals, controlled actions, consent and channel enforcement, grounded messages, and write-back audit.

## Success Criteria
No protected external action occurs without required identity, permission, policy, and approval checks.
acceptance_criteria: No protected external action occurs without required identity, permission, policy, and approval checks.

title: C08 User surfaces
description:
Build command center, queues, relationship explorer, evidence timeline, approvals, role views, Slack access, and Tableau views.

## Success Criteria
Roles see consistent facts with permission-appropriate access and actions.
acceptance_criteria: Roles see consistent facts with permission-appropriate access and actions.

title: C09 Workforce relationships
description:
Map skills, role requirements, feedback, development, workload, opportunities, and restricted employee cases.

## Success Criteria
The system proposes evidence-backed staffing or development actions without exposing protected employee data.
acceptance_criteria: The system proposes evidence-backed staffing or development actions without exposing protected employee data.

title: C10 Dependency and operational impact
description:
Map supplier, system, service, asset, contract, and organizational dependencies and coordinate remediation.

## Success Criteria
A failed dependency identifies affected relationships and commitments and tracks remediation to closure.
acceptance_criteria: A failed dependency identifies affected relationships and commitments and tracks remediation to closure.
